Manage the end-to-end Personal Loan lifecycle, including customer onboarding, eligibility assessment, credit evaluation, offer generation, lender matching and loan disbursal.

Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, digital lending guidelines, consent management, data privacy and product risk controls.
